svg.title: Example with made-up inputs: points value against a higher dispensing fee
svg.desc: Example with made-up inputs, not real prices; the reader should plug in their own quotes. An illustrative extra dispensing fee of 4 dollars a fill, 12 times a year, is 48 dollars. An illustrative points conversion of 12 dollars does not cover that gap. Neither figure is a PC Optimum rate or a pharmacy quote.
svg.text: Example: a bonus has to beat the extra fee
Example with made-up inputs ($4 extra fee, $12 of points). Plug in your own numbers.
$48 minus $12 is $36 still paid for the higher fee. Change either input and the gap changes.
Where the regulator bans points on prescriptions, the green bar on the prescription itself is $0.
